title: Dissociable cerebellar pathways for reach correction and learning
title_zh: 运动纠正与学习的可分小脑通路
abstract: Sensory feedback can trigger rapid motor corrections, but how self-generated movement errors are corrected and influence subsequent behavior remains less clear. Here, we found that corrective submovements (CSMs), structured, feedback-driven adjustments, occurred either spontaneously or in response to neural perturbations during mouse reaching. Corrections were modestly encoded in the cerebellar anterior interposed nucleus (IntA) along with non-corrective reach kinematic correlates. Closed-loop perturbations directed to red nucleus-projecting neurons were readily compensated for with corrective movements and led to learned shifts in the timing of future submovements, while perturbations to IntA more broadly were not compensated for and produced no learning. Thus, subsets of IntA outputs differentially permit or corrupt accurate corrections and subsequent learning, respectively.
abstract_zh: 感觉反馈可以触发快速运动纠正，但自我产生的运动错误如何被纠正并影响后续行为尚不十分清楚。本研究发现，在小鼠抓取过程中，结构化的反馈驱动调整——矫正副运动（CSMs）——可自发发生，或对神经扰动作出反应。矫正过程在小脑前间插核（IntA）中得到适度编码，同时伴随非矫正的抓取运动学相关性。定向至投射至红核的神经元的闭环扰动可通过矫正动作轻易补偿，并导致后续副运动时序发生学习性转移；而对IntA更广泛区域的扰动则未得到补偿，也未产生学习。因此，IntA输出的不同子集分别允许或破坏精确矫正及后续学习。
